case_number: 2025 INSC 207; CIVIL APPEAL No.__________ OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP (C) No. 34338 OF 2016)

parties.respondent: Housing and Urban Development Corporation Limited and Another

summary: Land allotment dispute; failure to execute sub-lease due to lack of perpetual lease with HUDCO; payment installments contingent upon execution of agreement; breach attributed to respondent's inability to perform; high court's reversal of concurrent findings set aside; declaratory relief restored; maintainability upheld.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; declaratory relief in favour of appellant upheld; suit declared maintainable.
